style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=11;fontColor=#9aa0b4;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=0;" value="Nine pillars, booking first. Each organisation applies its own visual identity (Brand) wherever its people see spaceweave. Floor plans matter for three things only: turning a drawing into a bookable inventory, keeping identity across revised drawings (RevisionMapping), and drawing a recognisable map, so walls, doors and windows are render layers of a revision, not domain entities. Allocation is a generic weekly batch, desks first, alongside self-service hot desks: people request a kind of space by its labels, requests are grouped, and groups are packed onto floors under a configurable AllocationPolicy; Rules govern allocation, booking and check-in. References to Person, Group and Role are written in the cards (→). Each relation is coloured by the pillar it starts from. Grey dashed = spaceweave-owned, not offered by any surveyed vendor." vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="30" y="54" width="4369" height="48" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="lg0" parent="1" div.div: Nine pillars, booking first. Each organisation applies its own visual identity (Brand) wherever its people see spaceweave. Floor plans matter for three things only: turning a drawing into a bookable inventory, keeping identity across revised drawings (RevisionMapping), and drawing a recognisable map, so walls, doors and windows are render layers of a revision, not domain entities. Allocation is a generic weekly batch, desks first, alongside self-service hot desks: people request a kind of space by its labels, requests are grouped, and groups are packed onto floors under a configurable AllocationPolicy; Rules govern allocation, booking and check-in. References to Person, Group and Role are written in the cards (→). Each relation is coloured by the pillar it starts from. Grey dashed = spaceweave-owned, not offered by any surveyed vendor.
